page.layout: One title page, single column, centred. Top: a script line with the author's name. Then the title block in capitals and italic lines, a red-letter area, a printer's ornament, and the imprint at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Typis J. Fletcher, sumptibus Ric. Mynne, in vico vulgò dicto, Little Britaine; sub insigne S. Pauli. An. D. 1650.

page.notes: The first line is a script author name, read as "Mericí Casauboni, I.F." with the last letters doubtful. The "QUATUOR" word is partly obscured by a red seal stamp, so the initial letters are uncertain. The printer's name "Flesher" is read as "Flesher" with a doubtful long s; the imprint year is "1650" in old-style figures. Red print marks the words Ric. Mynne, Pars prior and the year. The woodcut ornament and red seal are not text. Some letters at the head of the title are obscured by the seal and a handwritten mark.
